verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack claims or shows that a founder can fully onboard onto Brex in about a week. The Onboarding API only covers referrals and prefilling signup data, and the integrations and Pipedream bulk-user material concerns setup after an account exists, not onboarding timelines. Community accounts describe a long, painful signup, repeated application rejections and a rescinded approval. Because Brex makes no vendor claim about onboarding speed, those reports cannot create a dispute; the verdict is simply none.
